package.name: wasp_autonomous_systems_interfaces
package.description: Compatibility shim providing the pre-rename message package name so that older recorded rosbags (e.g. rosbags/real_robot) - whose /motor/encoders and /motor/duty_cyles topics were recorded under this package name before the wasp_autonomous_systems -> wasp_as rename - can still be deserialized and replayed by ros2 bag play. Field layouts mirror wasp_as_interfaces exactly; see that package for the canonical, actively-used definitions.
package.author: Daniel Duberg
